title: psoralea dentata
intro: Psoralea dentata, commonly known as Huang Qi or Huang Qi Ye, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea dentata include promoting wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects, while its bioactive constituents include isoflavones, coumarins, and lignans, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, Psoralea dentata has been traditionally used to treat conditions such as fever, cough, and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its expectorant and anti-ulcerative properties.
